title: What changed in the CRS project recently?

messages.content: What changed in the CRS project recently?

Recent activity is all dated **today, 2026-07-17** — a busy session. Here's what changed, grouped by theme:

**QA loop on the CRS Brain app** (biggest thread)
- Cycle-1: 72/82 checks PASS → 5 fixes applied + P9.6 deliverables (`9177b95`)
- Cycle-2 (partial): re-verified 13 static rows + 7 Progress-Tree rows via a new headless test rig (`c0af2eb`, HEAD)

**CRS Brain app / pages**
- Progress Tree (`tree.html`) redesigned into a two-renderer Executive/Raw view (`0e5701f`, `59d2cf3`)
- Ideas board added (`c2c6aa9`, `b1f6354`, `0f49bc8`)
- Windows portability fixes so the app runs on this machine (`e9c6120`, `910f40b`)

**Knowledge base (`brain/`)**
- Ingested *The Ultimate Guide to Bubble Performance* (Petter Amlie, 227pp PDF) as a new `brain/bubble-performance/` domain — verbatim per-chapter markdown + INDEX, labeled third-party guidance (`b642387`…`5027755`)
- Bubble forum digest + Bubble issue report added (`5a0636f`, `97396e9`, `6ca3e25`)
- Weekly digest generated for 2026-07-17 (`c1dee00`)
- Image-generation capability note (`8a1abf0`)

**Uncommitted right now:** `CRS_Spec-13.html` and a `qa-scratch/` folder are untracked (likely QA-loop scratch output).

Net: no Bubble schema or module changes — module count still 46, still 0/46 DTs Pattern-A compliant. This session was app QA, the Progress Tree redesign, and knowledge-base ingestion. Want me to dig into any one of these?
